description.narrative: The project is expected to provide access to finance for individuals to support economic activity and resilience in the context of a fragile economy. Beyond the project outcome, IFC anticipates that the project will support resilience amongst microfinance and BoP finance providers catalyzing investments in the sector by demonstrating the viability of lending to BoP providers and crowding in other sources of international and domestic finance in support of these lenders.

The proposed project consists of an up to 3-year unsecured senior loan of up to XAF1.9 billion or approximately US$3 million equivalent to Express Union Tchad (EUT or the MFI) to help increase its lending capacity to retail borrowers in Chad. The financing package will comprise up to XAF 625 million (c. US$1 million) from IFCs own account and mobilization from other lenders of up to XAF 1.25 billion (c. US$2 million). The project will be processed under IFCs COVID Base of Pyramid (BOP) Facility and will make use of the IDA Private Sector Window (PSW) Pooled First Loss Guarantee (PFLG) as well as the Local Currency Facility (LCF).
